setup.text: A storyteller wonders whether distant people could earn a living by creating performances, stories, games, or images.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A singer imagines reaching listeners on another shore.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A craftsperson wonders how creators could be paid without losing control of their work.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A shy villager fears strangers judging every performance.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A child thinks recognition sounds wonderful until the storyteller asks about privacy.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The council imagines machines copying a singer's voice without permission.

c2.text: A researcher asks whether copying a style is the same as stealing a specific work.
